# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Young adult (similar in age to Anne Shirley and Jane Andrews)
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Farmer

## Appearance

Billy is described as a large, stout young man with a broad, round, freckled face. He has pale blue eyes and a somewhat slow, heavy appearance. His expression is generally good-natured, though lacking in animation or intellectual spark.

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy, slow-witted, and awkward, particularly around women. He is a good-hearted, industrious, and simple country young man who prefers farming and quiet living over intellectual pursuits or social lively conversation. He lacks confidence in social settings, often relying on his sister Jane to speak or act on his behalf in matters of romance.

## Traits

- Shy and bashful
- Slow-witted
- Good-natured
- Hardworking

## Abilities

- Practical farming and agriculture

## Goals

- To settle down as a farmer and find a wife

## History

Billy Andrews grows up in Avonlea as the brother of Jane, Prissie, and Nettie Andrews. During his school days, he is a quiet student who rarely participates in the imaginative games of Anne Shirley and her friends. As he grows into young adulthood, he takes up farming in Avonlea and becomes a solid, respectable worker. In *Anne of the Island*, Billy decides he wants to marry Anne Shirley, but he is far too timid to propose to her himself. Instead, he sends his sister Jane to deliver his proposal of marriage on his behalf. Anne promptly and politely declines the indirect offer, which Billy takes in stride without much lasting heartbreak, eventually moving on to marry Nettie Blewett.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea as part of the prominent Andrews family.
- Attended the local Avonlea school alongside Anne Shirley and her peers.

## Affiliations

- The Andrews Family — Son and brother
